supersedes.scope: Small-only compute default and requirement to prove Small representation ceiling before larger-backbone research. Historical evidence and exact replay contracts remain unchanged.

runtime_gaps: Current DINOv2-S authority loader rejects other architecture/weights; keep it for historical replay.
vNext inference and foundation cache enforce eight views and 384 dimensions.
V3.2.3 trained feature fusion assumes 576 channels and calibrated camera inputs.
Implement new versioned single-view frontend, backbone-specific projection, visible-view selection and cache/checkpoint identities; do not loosen historical validators.
No larger encoder weight load, GPU parity or single-view completion evaluation has been executed.
single_view_evaluation_required: All arms receive exactly one real RGB view; remaining real renders are target-only.
Changing hidden target images/cameras must not change inference conditioning.
Disjoint lineage train/validation/global-unseen; no split minted from candidate count.
Evaluate observed and occluded geometry/appearance separately using only qualified target families; masked regions never count as successes.
Compare geometry, normals, appearance high-frequency detail, completion failures, peak VRAM, latency and feature-cache bytes.
Declare pretrained 3D reconstruction prior or from-scratch decoder explicitly; a larger 2D encoder is not a pretrained 3D completion model.
Any synthesized views/normals are predicted conditions with provenance, never independent truth.
Select a separate single-view model/camera/pose interface; no eight-view repeat or source-bound camera/scale leakage.

active_scope.priority: Finish current exact370 source truth, family/head coverage, lineage split and materialization; repair current model/truth interfaces.
active_scope.training_blockers: Existing corpus/model/target/readiness gates remain; single-view capability is a separate later product milestone.

future_single_view_frontend.input_guidance: Front-facing character image; orthographic assumption must be declared and validated.
future_single_view_frontend.camera_layout: Prefer existing eight-camera canonical orbit, subject to exact normalization and axis binding.
future_single_view_frontend.normalization: Input camera simplification does not remove pose, scale and common-frame requirements.
future_single_view_frontend.producer: Joint camera-conditioned RGB/normal prediction; pretrained compatible multiview/3D prior must be assessed separately.
future_single_view_frontend.comparison: Six-view baseline may be compared later; no claim eight is empirically optimal.
